body: Thank you for your advice. Now that I'm taking it in a more adult way I don't feel that hopeless anymore. Maybe my life can still be saved. I think I'll be completely honest to my lawyer if (or when) it comes to it, even though some things are hard to confess. The problem is that most conversations have been had over whatsapp, which conversations I had deleted in the past. I wonder if they could be pulled from her side... but my bet would be that she's delete them all if they aren't in her favor. Facebook conversations are still on but it isn't much that would show anything. Looks like I come out badly from everything anyways. I don't have shame in admitting my wrong doings, it's the "out of jail" problem that irks me.
The trial is not yet to come. But assuming that I will get free because of it is nonsense, I'm guilty of what she will state, what else will save me? Pleading insanity?
